steps.text: Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.

Mix chicken, bread crumbs, egg, lemon juice, sun-dried tomatoes, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper together in a bowl; form mixture into 5 patties. Divide feta cheese into 5 equal portions; place a portion of feta cheese atop each patty and fold chicken mixture around cheese to secure it in the center.

Cook patties on the preheated grill until no longer pink on the inside and juices run clear, 5 to 7 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 165 degrees F (75 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Greek Chicken Burgers with Feta
raw_recipe.description: These juicy grilled Greek-inspired chicken burgers made with ground chicken, sun-dried tomatoes, and oregano have a surprise feta cheese filling.

review.reviewBody: I'm not sure why they took off my recommendation when I posted the recipe - I suggested serving them with a roasted red pepper sauce, but tzatziki or something similar would be just as good. Definitely better with some sort of sauce though, I agree!

Loved it! Changes: used 1/2 tsp dried oregano and 1 tsp epicure Greek spice, and 1 tbsp finely minced onion. Was very wet, so divided into 5 balls and chilled an hour. Divided feta, then dipped ball in cornmeal so it wouldn't stick to my palm, stuffed in the feta, folded over and then dipped the top in cornmeal and onto the George Forman 6-7 min. Served over chopped cucumber and tomato with 1/4 tsp epicure tzatziki dip spice and fresh cilantro, topped the burger with tzatziki and a side of fresh crisped nan. 
Was moist in the centre with an appealing texture from the cornmeal on the outside.

I made these tonight, thought they were delicious and flavorful. I added some chopped spinach because that’s what I planned before I saw this recipe. I did cooked them in a frying pan with a little oil. (It was raining). I didn’t have sun-dried tomatoes…..but the rest of the ingredients were the same……I mixed the feta into the mixture and it was fine. Will make them again.

Loved it. Instead of the fresh basil and sun dried tomatoes, I used a basil pesto and sundried tomato pesto.. I shallow fried them for just a bit before putting them on the BBQ so it didn't crumble.. put 2 eggs instead of one. Instead of bread crumbs, just pulverized a toast. :) Nailed it.

Have had his recipe for a while in my box, but today I decided on ground chicken burgers. Changed this a little bit. Added egg, Panko crumbs, lemon jce and had some roasted red peppers w/garlic so added instead of sun-dried tomatoes. Very moist & delish. Added dried oregano and basil and dried cumin, coriander, ginger, tarragon, curry powder & garlic powder. Skipped salt & pepper. Had some fat free feta and put that into the ground chicken. Heated my favorite non-stick pan w/light olive oil and made the burgers in about 15 minutes. Great flavor and exremely moist & flavorful. Could use sun-dried tomatoes next time but this was great. Served with a simple salad and homemade honey mustard dressing. WOW!

Incredible! I double the recipe using one pound dark ground chicken and one pound white ground chicken. Serve with homemade tzatiki sauce, sliced red onion, tomato on a toasted brioche bun. Excellent. I freeze extra burgers for another time. I make this recipe often.

Excellent fast dinner! I put a low carb spin on this one... replaced bread crumbs with 1/3 cup coconut flour and used capers instead of sun dried tomatoes. I also amped up the lemon and oregano and skipped the basil.

Served them along side a nice garden salad with vinaigrette! I will be making these weekly for sure!

OH and they are equally as good cold later this evening!

We really like these and regularly make them.
I used dried herbs. 
1 tsp. of oregano,
1 tsp. basil and no tomatoes.
1 tsp. salt
1/4 pepper
I also mixed everything together.
I cooked these in a pan, using a lid at times to cook through and maintain the moisture. I preferred them on the stove, rather than the broiler.

This is our new favorite way to eat burgers...at least while we are dieting. I've never put the lemon juice in it because I normally don't have any in the house and I can't find sun dried tomatoes in my store for some reason, so I put a little bit of sun dried tomato pesto in the chicken mixture. I also don't bother "folding" in the feta (reduced fat) and just mix into the meat before forming them into patties. I like to top it with tzatsciki sauce, but I'm sure anything you want to top it with would work. The burgers always come out juicy and taste great!

First off- until now I hated ground chicken. I found a package on sale and couldn't resist, then set out to find a tolerable way to eat it. Oh MY ! I made this as stated, using what is on hand, so soft fresh breadcrumbs, skipped the tomato. I pan-fried in a little olive oil , and topped with roasted red peppers from the jar on sandwich thins. What a keeper this is. Thank you.
UPDATE : Okay now I'm hooked on ground chicken. The next logicl step - bought skinless boneless chicken breast (much cheaper) and used the food processor and 'ground' my own chicken - wow ! It's even better - if that's possible. I've now made them 4 times- I am loving this , Again, thank you :)

I thought this was an excellent way to eat a burger in a more healthier way than red meat. I did add a little more sun-dried tomatoes and herbs and also some minced garlic but we are garlic loving family! Also instead of "folding" in the feta, I made two thin patties, added feta put the two together and mashed and pinched the sides together to keep closed. I didn't really understand the folding in thing. I would need to see someone do it to be know what they are talking about. 
I also used Tzatziki sauce on the burgers as a condiment. I will definitely make it again!
Skipped tomatoes. Dried oregano and fresh basil. On pretzel bun.
I had to limit salt due to husband’s medical condition, otherwise this recipe has potential. Healthy alternative with good flavors, I’ll up the basil and sundried tomatoes next time,
We liked it! I followed the recipe & served it on toasted wheat bread with sliced onions & tomatoes.
I used sun dried tomato basil in the recipe to cover the sun dried tomato, basil, oregano and add some more flavor. It turned out delicious!!!!!

Who knew ground chicken could be so exciting? Fresh basil and fresh oregano make this a super flavourful burger. Grill to perfection and remove when the char marks are just visible. Overcooking this would be a terrible unforgiveable sin. Don't be that person.
I only had dried spices, but these came out great!
These were a nice change from burgers on the grill. Tasty, and not too difficult.

My DH and I loved this. Perfect amount of everything. Had to cook in a skillet because the meat was so soft even after refrigerating. Had no trouble with them drying out at all.
We needed no condiments either; they were juicy and delicious. DH says this is a keeper. Will make again. Thanks for the post!
Excellent recipe. I would recommend the ingredients list be updated to reflect 1 tablespoon of Oregano though, since 3 tsp = 1 tbsp. One less thing to wash!
